x: Bridger, Heather, Thaxter, Roberts, Doubleday, Snell, and others, supporting Bert Clayton, our Eastleigh member, who may win the individual title, is certainly a team of possibilities.

Clayton, Heather, Roberts, Thaxter, Doubleday, Bridger, Goold, Elliott, East, Snell and others have great potentialities, and with conscientious, steady training, we may expect a team which will represent the Club with credit.

After a small lap of the Common, Clayton was still leading, Eddie Heather having worked his way into second place. These two were still leading at the top of the hills, with Roberts leading Thaxter and Doubleday for third place.
Len Coleman, fourth "A" team man, also moved up, and Eddie Heather, of the "B" team, and Bert Clayton, fifth and non-scoring "A" team man, rendered yeoman service.

Other new arrivals for Belgrave parents are; a son -Steven -for Alan and Ann Painter and a daughter -Heather- for Chris and Glynis Tapling. Colin Gaynor has gone up to Loughborough University for 1 year to study Recreational Management.
